decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight was launched only in 2023 and still has its own product page, so its value is not yet resolved; it fits the firm's modular system portfolio and costs little to keep listed, so the option should stay open.

The LED ceiling luminaire is a recent launch with no negative signals and still has its own product page; keeping it in a broad catalog costs little while dealer and planner uptake is still uncertain, so abandonment is premature.
